text:
```yaml
name: Repomix

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  repomix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true

      - name: Pack repository with Repomix
        uses: repomix/repomix-action@latest
        with:
          compress: true

      - name: Upload repomix artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: repomix-output
          path: repomix-output.tar.gz
```
